name: FireRed-OpenStoryline
description: FireRed-OpenStoryline is an AI video editing agent that transforms manual editing into intention-driven directing through natural language interaction, LLM-powered planning, and precise tool orchestration. It facilitates transparent, human-in-the-loop creation with reusable Style Skills for consistent, professional storytelling.
summary: FireRed-OpenStoryline：FireRed-OpenStoryline 是一款将手动编辑转化为意图驱动的导演的 AI 视频编辑代理，通过自然语言交互、LLM 规划以及精确的工具编排实现。它支持透明、人机共存的创作流程，并采用可复用的风格技能，确保专业且连贯的叙事。适合在 Claude、Codex、OpenClaw 相关工作流里先做选型判断。
categoryDescription: 图片、视频、演示、写作、音频与社交内容生产
howToUse: 阅读仓库 README 的安装要求，将 Skill、插件或工具接入对应环境，再按文档触发工作流。
installCommand:
npx clawhub install openstoryline-install
npx clawhub install openstoryline-use
